overview.description: The iPath Series B Carbon Exchange-Traded Notes (GRN) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Barclays Global Carbon II TR USD index. The fund is an ETN that tracks a liquidity-weighted index of carbon-related credit plans. The index holds December futures contracts on EUAs and CERs. GRN was launched on Sep 10, 2019 and is issued by iPath.
infoTable: Barclays Global Carbon II TR USD
